Denial of Service.note: The broad project family contains DDoS and several DoS variants. Packet, service, and endpoint evidence is required to choose the most specific technique or sub-technique.

Port Scan.note: Operational enrichment for service/port discovery behavior. External active scanning may require a different ATT&CK context.

Brute Force.note: The dataset family combines FTP-Patator and SSH-Patator. The exact T1110 sub-technique requires authentication evidence.

Web Attack.note: Family-level enrichment for SQL injection, XSS, and web brute-force records. Not every web request proves successful exploitation.

Other Malicious.note: This combined family contains Bot, Infiltration, and Heartbleed. There is no defensible single ATT&CK technique without the original label and supporting network/host evidence.

Anomalous / Unmapped.note: An anomaly is a behavioral deviation, not an ATT&CK technique. Analyst investigation is required before mapping.

BENIGN.note: No ATT&CK enrichment is applied to non-alerting traffic.
